I have a work meeting during the morning delivery. Could you help move my lamp delivery? Please use this order-linked message thread.
Dispatch has offered 2026-02-03 15:00–18:00 or 2026-02-04 10:00–13:00, both at no charge. Which should I ask them to book?
Please choose 2026-02-03 15:00–18:00. I will be home then.
Sorry, my meeting has just been cancelled. Please do not move the delivery after all. I would rather keep the original morning slot on 2026-02-03.

Vessa Lorne has withdrawn her request to move DL-001. Please make no further change to DL-001. Please tell us whether our booking request for 2026-02-03 15:00–18:00 was already applied, and what DL-001's saved slot is now.

Vessa's stop is noted on DL-001 and nothing further will change. Your booking request was applied at 09:56: DL-001 is reserved for 2026-02-03 15:00–18:00 and the morning slot was released. Restoring 09:00–12:00 would be a separate request. Nothing has been delivered.
